text:
Dalia: AtlasCloud asked us to produce a multi-region reference architecture + Terraform modules for their marketplace image. They want: regional failover example, minimal IAM roles, and an install README by next Thurs. Who can pair on this?
Ravi: I can take the multi-region module. Plan: `module "atlas_marketplace" { source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-modules/atlas" region_list = ["us-west-2", "eu-west-1"] instance_type_map = { us-west-2 = "g5.12xlarge" eu-west-1 = "p4d.24xlarge" } }`
Jo: I'll author the refarch diagram + the ops playbook (runbooks for scaling and disaster recovery). Keep it slim: architecture diagram + bullets for routing, cache, kv sync.
Clara: Packaging: need partner-signed manifest, image provenance, and a short compatibility table. @Dalia confirm whether AtlasCloud will provide signed images and a CVE report.
Dalia: They will provide signed OCI images and a CVE scan report weekly. Also asked for a short perf blurb for our listing (non-prod numbers only).
Ravi: Suggest adding a `hardware_profile` var so users can select: `hardware_profile = "h100-optimized" | "gpu-general"` and module outputs an SKU list.
Jo: Ops TODO: add `scripts/verify-deploy.sh` to repo with checks: health endpoint, latency check, sample generation. Example: `./scripts/verify-deploy.sh --region eu-west-1 --image redwood/atlas:stable`
Clara: CI: add `marketplace/publish-check` GH action that runs: build image, SBOM generation, infra smoke deploy (on ephemeral acct), teardown. Keep it gated for partner PRs.
partner-onboard-bot: Ticket CREATED P-3480: "AtlasCloud multi-region refarch + marketplace module" assigned to @Ravi and linked to sprint-23.
Ravi: I'll open the initial scaffolding PR today. Can someone else add a tiny sample client (curl + python) and a couple of canned prompts for basic smoke/latency checks?
Jo: I can add `examples/minimal-client` with a Python snippet and a README step-by-step.
Clara: Also add a short security checklist in the README: KMS for keys, restrict SGs, minimal IAM, image signing verification step.
Dalia: Great. Let's meet Friday 9:30am PT for design review. I'll share AtlasCloud's device matrix and the signed-image url beforehand.
